_about: Hand-curated inputs for ingest/build_study_team_roster.py and ingest/extract_people.py, for cases the credits-page extraction cannot settle. 'pdf_for' pairs a catalog entry with its original PDF when the body-text match is not confident (each pairing checked by cover title and page count). 'authors' sets authorship directly where a document carries a byline ('By ...', 'Authors: ...') instead of a study-team page; names there need not be in the roster, and each was read from the document itself.
